workspaces.description:
图表原型库：7 种 Swift Charts 基础 Mark、23 种 ECharts 核心 series 与常用变体，以及 Vela OHLCV 蜡烛图、均线与技术指标、12 种 Vega-Lite 图表和 2 个 HTML/CSS 示例；使用少量离线虚构数据，另保留 HTTP 和布局示例。图表与看板文案支持中英切换。
Chart gallery with all seven Swift Charts marks, 23 core ECharts series and common variants, plus Vela OHLCV candles and technical indicators, 12 Vega-Lite charts and two HTML/CSS examples. Uses small fictional offline datasets, with HTTP and layout examples. Chart and dashboard text follows the app's Chinese or English language setting.
